---
name: Dispute a rule
about: Claim that a rule is wrong, too broad, too narrow or unclear
title: "G-<section>.<n>: <the claim>"
---

**Rule:** G-<section>.<n>

**Claim:** what the rule gets wrong, in one sentence.

**Evidence:** the code, the measurement, or the case where following the rule makes the code worse. Name the JDK,
the machine and the command for a measurement.

**Proposed change:** the new wording, a narrower scope, or withdrawal.
